lines: Out of 100 real online-shop customers, 58 give 5, 19 give 4, 8 give 3, 3 give 2 and 11 give 1.
Delivery on time or early: average 4.29. 1-3 days late: 3.25. 4-7 days late: 2.11. 8+ days late: 1.68 (71% give 1). Never delivered: 1.71.

shots.prompt: You are a customer of ShopNova, an online shop. Your order arrived 26 days after the promised delivery date. Now you are asked to rate your purchase experience.
shots.comment: It never came on time, terrible.

shots.prompt: You are a customer of ShopNova, an online shop. Your order arrived 10 days before the promised date. Now you are asked to rate your purchase experience.
You are a customer of ShopNova, an online shop. Your order arrived 6 days after the promised delivery date. Now you are asked to rate your purchase experience.
shots.comment: Late and nobody told me anything.

shots.prompt: You are a customer of ShopNova, an online shop. Your order arrived on time. Now you are asked to rate your purchase experience.
You are a customer of ShopNova, an online shop. Your order arrived 3 days after the promised delivery date. Now you are asked to rate your purchase experience.
shots.comment: It arrived, but later than I hoped.

source: Olist Brazilian E-Commerce order reviews (Kaggle olistbr), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, train split only; only structured fields used (no Portuguese text); shot comments written by us, shot scores real
